references.text: The priest presents the person before the Lord's presence, a parallel to how the priest was to present the woman before the Lord in the ritual of purification.
Continuation of the same ritual where the priest presents the woman before the Lord's presence and loosens her hair.
Summary of the law concerning jealousy, where the priest is to present the woman before the Lord and carry out this entire law for her.
Moses brought their case before the Lord's presence, using the same expression for bringing a matter before the Lord.
The two men who have a dispute shall stand before the Lord's presence, before the priests and judges, a similar legal presentation before the Lord.
Samuel commanded the people to present themselves before the Lord's presence, by tribes and clans, using the same concept of standing before the Lord.
